text: Tamar and Pieter got engaged on Saturday! He proposed on the beach at Holkham. She sounded so happy on the phone.
Yaw's cat Biscuit has kidney problems and goes in for bloods on Thursday. He's really worried about her.
Need to send Freya a card for her and Dev's tenth anniversary next Tuesday.
Oliver is moving to Glasgow in a fortnight for the new job. His girlfriend Mila is staying in Leeds until the spring, which he's not thrilled about.
Krisztina has a flat viewing in Clapton tomorrow morning. Text her that evening to see how it went.
Picked up a new puppy food sample for Lola's spaniel. Drop it round this weekend.
Heather mentioned her parents' fortieth anniversary is the 14th. They're having a lunch at the Swan the day after.
Mandla's dog Toffee turns one on Friday. Apparently there's a cake made of liver. Not invited, sadly.

Coffee with Eli. He and his husband Arjun are finally house hunting in Bristol. They want a garden for the dogs and somewhere near a decent bakery. Eli works from home now so he's not fussed about the commute, but Arjun still has to be in the office three days a week.
Zhang's wedding has been called off. She and Milan split up last month. Be gentle when I see her on Sunday.
Remember: Chloe is allergic to cats, so no dinner at mine while the kittens are here.
Teresa's new kitten is called Pepper. Tiny, grey, and already terrorising her husband.
Khadija starts packing on Wednesday and the removal van comes the following Monday. I'm helping her move the plants the day before.
Ring Nia about Magda's hen do. Need to know numbers by Friday.
Bogdan sounded flat on the phone. His old cat Mishka was put to sleep yesterday. He's had her since uni. I should pop round with something next week.
Ximena and Kevin's wedding is on the 2nd of May. Save the date arrived today. Book the hotel before it fills up.
Sophie got the keys to her first flat this morning! Moves in properly next Saturday.

Ebony's brother Emeka is getting married in Lagos in December. She's flying out a week before to help with everything and coming back on Boxing Day. Her mum is apparently running the whole thing like a military operation, and Ebony has been put in charge of the cake, which she's quietly panicking about.
Dmitri and his wife are celebrating their silver anniversary next weekend. He's been dropping hints that she'd love a new watch strap, but he can't decide which colour.
Book the vet for the boosters. Ask about the lump on her ear while I'm there.
Mohammed is nervous about the viewing on Saturday. It's the third flat this month and he really wants this one. Send him a good luck message the night before.
Pedro, aka Pete, is a vegan now. Has been since August apparently.
Emeka's daughter has her christening on Sunday the 9th. Ahmed and I are both going, so sort out a lift.

Freya's mum had a fall last week and is moving in with them for a while. Freya is exhausted. Dev is trying to clear the spare room, their two kids are sharing for now, and the anniversary trip to Rome is on hold. Check in with her on Thursday, and maybe drop off a lasagne at the weekend.
Tamar asked if I'd do a reading at the wedding. Said yes. Need to find something that isn't Corinthians.
Quick one: Lola's rabbit Clover has been off her food since Monday and goes to the vet tomorrow afternoon.
Heather Morris, my old landlady, is selling the house on Elm Road and moving to Portugal next spring. She already has a little place in Tavira lined up.
Got the new flat viewing booked for Tuesday at six. Bring the tape measure and check the water pressure.
Oliver and Mila's first anniversary is Sunday. He's planning a surprise picnic and asked me to keep quiet. Ask him afterwards how it went.
Arjun's puppy, Mango, has his first vet appointment on Monday. The day after that he's allowed out for walks.
Pieter has decided he wants a dog after the wedding. Tamar is not convinced.

Lunch with Yaw. Biscuit's bloods came back better than expected, so the vet wants another check in two weeks. He was so relieved. Also said his sister Nia is pregnant with her second, due in March, and he's going to be godfather again. He's thinking of moving closer to her once his lease is up in the summer.
Must post Khadija's housewarming present before Friday. She wanted a nice olive oil and some plant cuttings.
Milan's moving back in with his parents for a few months after the breakup. He said he's fine but didn't sound it.
Mandla and his partner Chloe just bought a place in Margate. Completion is next Thursday and they're having friends over the weekend after.
Krisztina didn't get the Clapton flat. She's viewing two more on Saturday and will decide that afternoon.
Teresa Lopez is a vet nurse at the practice on Mill Lane. Good to know for Pepper.
Note to self: renew the parking permit before the move, and redirect post the week before.
Eli said Arjun proposed to him on their anniversary in Lisbon! They're thinking of a small wedding next autumn. Send them a bottle of something nice this week.
Dev loves birds. Has two budgies, Kiwi and Pip, and wants an African grey one day.

Zhang's moving into her own flat in Hackney on the 1st. It's her first time living alone and she admitted she's a bit scared of it, especially after everything with Milan. Her sister is lending her a van. Offer to help with the boxes that weekend and maybe take her out for dinner the evening after.

Magda's hen do is in Bath the weekend before the wedding. The wedding itself is on the 21st and she's doing the seating plan herself, which she is already dreading. Her fiancé Pedro is useless with that sort of thing, apparently.

Bogdan's new rescue dog arrives on Saturday. A greyhound called Lady, six years old, retired from racing. He's taking the Monday off to settle her in and has bought about four beds already. He says it doesn't replace Mishka but the flat felt too quiet. Pop round the week after to meet her.
Uncle Emeka retires at the end of the month and Aunty Magda is throwing him a party the Saturday after. I'm bringing the jollof.
Sophie's cat went missing two days ago. She's put posters up everywhere. Text her tonight and ask if there's any news.

Ximena sounded stressed. Kevin's job in Manchester starts on the 3rd, so they're moving in three weeks and haven't even found a flat yet. She's going up on Friday for viewings and coming back on Sunday night.
Ahmed and his wife Khadija have their anniversary on Wednesday. He wants restaurant recommendations by tomorrow.

Long chat with Ebony about her move to Edinburgh. She's taking the job at the university in January, but her partner Dmitri is staying in London until his contract ends in April. Their cat, Luna, is going with her. She's anxious about being on her own up there and about finding somewhere that allows pets. Ring her next Sunday after her first round of viewings.
Don't forget Mila's birthday is the day after Oliver's leaving drinks. Get her those gardening gloves she mentioned.
Pieter's mum is having her hip done on Tuesday. He's driving her in that morning and staying the night.
Nia's due date got moved to the 2nd of March.
Yaw adopted a second cat, a ginger kitten called Mango. Biscuit is not impressed.
Kevin asked whether we could take their dog for the week they're moving. Said yes, from Thursday to the following Wednesday.
Mohammed got the flat! Moves in a week on Saturday. Send congrats and ask if he needs a hand on the day.

Heather's granddaughter got engaged at the weekend. Heather is over the moon and already knitting things. The fiancé is a Spanish lad called Pedro Garcia who works as a chef, and they're thinking of a wedding in Seville next summer. Heather is nervous about the flight but determined to go.
Bins go out Tuesday night now, not Wednesday.
Chloe and Mandla's house is chaos. Builders until Christmas, and the dog keeps escaping through the back fence.

Krisztina finally found a flat! She moves in on the 15th and her parents are driving down from Hull the day before to help. It's a one-bed above a bakery in Walthamstow, with a tiny balcony she's very excited about. Landlord is fine with her bringing the cat. Housewarming probably a couple of weeks after.
Dmitri says Ebony hates surprises, so no surprise leaving do. Just dinner on Friday with a few of us.
Tamar and Pieter's wedding is 12 June. Engagement party first, in a fortnight, at her sister's.
